notes: In-battle banter lines, triggered by BattleManager when specific character pairs are present in the active party. Each pair_key maps to an array of exchange objects. BattleManager should pick one exchange at random and play lines sequentially.

lines.speaker: druidess
lines.text: Stop doing that.

lines.speaker: dreamwalker
lines.text: I haven't done anything.

lines.speaker: druidess
lines.text: You were about to say something I was already thinking. Stop it.

lines.speaker: dreamwalker
lines.text: ...That's not exactly how it works.

lines.speaker: druidess
lines.text: I don't care how it works.

lines.speaker: dreamwalker
lines.text: You're planning to use the root-bind on the one in the back.

lines.speaker: druidess
lines.text: I was.

lines.speaker: dreamwalker
lines.text: It won't hold. The soil here is wrong.

lines.speaker: druidess
lines.text: I can feel the soil, thank you.

lines.speaker: dreamwalker
lines.text: I know. I just wanted to say it first.

lines.speaker: druidess
lines.text: Do you find this amusing?

lines.speaker: dreamwalker
lines.text: A little. The way you bristle. It's like watching a cat at a reflection.

lines.speaker: druidess
lines.text: I am going to put a thistle in your bedroll.

lines.speaker: dreamwalker
lines.text: I know. It was worth it.

lines.speaker: dreamwalker
lines.text: You grew up near a fen.

lines.speaker: druidess
lines.text: Don't.

lines.speaker: dreamwalker
lines.text: It was a nice fen.

lines.speaker: druidess
lines.text: Focus on the enemies.

lines.speaker: michael
lines.text: You're holding the line too far forward. If they flank—

lines.speaker: kella
lines.text: They won't have time to flank.

lines.speaker: michael
lines.text: Kella—

lines.speaker: kella
lines.text: Watch.

lines.speaker: kella
lines.text: You trust me.

lines.speaker: michael
lines.text: I trust your instincts. It's your joints I'm worried about.

lines.speaker: kella
lines.text: My joints are fine.

lines.speaker: michael
lines.text: You've said that three fights in a row.

lines.speaker: kella
lines.text: They're fine.

lines.speaker: michael
lines.text: Afterwards, I want you to actually rest. Not sit at camp and sharpen things.

lines.speaker: kella
lines.text: The swords need sharpening.

lines.speaker: michael
lines.text: After. You rest.

lines.speaker: kella
lines.text: ...Yes, all right.

lines.speaker: kella
lines.text: If something goes wrong, go left.

lines.speaker: michael
lines.text: Why left?

lines.speaker: kella
lines.text: Because I'll be going right.

lines.speaker: michael
lines.text: That's not reassuring.

lines.speaker: kella
lines.text: It's efficient.

lines.speaker: hannah
lines.text: You're looking pale. More than usual. Let me—

lines.speaker: vampire
lines.text: I assure you, Saint, I am precisely as dead as I need to be.

lines.speaker: hannah
lines.text: Your left hand is trembling.

lines.speaker: vampire
lines.text: It does that. It has done that for two hundred years. I find it characterful.

lines.speaker: hannah
lines.text: I have a restorative salve. It works on most tissue.

lines.speaker: vampire
lines.text: Most.

lines.speaker: hannah
lines.text: It's never been tested on—

lines.speaker: vampire
lines.text: Hannah. I am fine. I am, in point of fact, technically not anything at all. It would be very difficult for me to be less fine than I already am.

lines.speaker: hannah
lines.text: ...I'm putting it in your bag.

lines.speaker: vampire
lines.text: Of course you are.

lines.speaker: hannah
lines.text: Doesn't it bother you? Not being able to heal?

lines.speaker: vampire
lines.text: I heal. Slowly. And messily. And generally in the wrong order.

lines.speaker: hannah
lines.text: That sounds terrible.

lines.speaker: vampire
lines.text: It is deeply unglamorous, yes.

lines.speaker: vampire
lines.text: I notice you heal the others first.

lines.speaker: hannah
lines.text: You always say you're fine.

lines.speaker: vampire
lines.text: I am always fine.

lines.speaker: hannah
lines.text: And yet.

lines.speaker: vampire
lines.text: ...Fair point, Saint.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Iris glances at the baby dragon. The baby dragon looks back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The baby dragon butts its head against her knee once, then turns back to the fight.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Iris holds out her hand before the baby dragon can charge forward. The dragon pauses.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The dragon sits. Waits. Then Iris nods, and they move together.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: After the fight the baby dragon climbs Iris's arm without asking. She lets it.

lines.speaker: fritzzit
lines.text: The big one has a cast-iron chassis but the rivets are copper! Copper! Do you know what that means??

lines.speaker: crankpot
lines.text: It means you should hit it instead of explaining it.

lines.speaker: fritzzit
lines.text: It means a Type-4 galvanic pulse would—

lines.speaker: crankpot
lines.text: Fritzzit.

lines.speaker: fritzzit
lines.text: Right, yes, hitting.

lines.speaker: fritzzit
lines.text: That automaton is running on a secondary power loop! If we sever the tertiary conduit on its LEFT side—

lines.speaker: crankpot
lines.text: I severed it thirty seconds ago.

lines.speaker: crankpot
lines.text: You were still talking.

lines.speaker: fritzzit
lines.text: It's beautiful, actually. As a machine. Don't you think? Functionally it's a masterpiece of horrible design but the tolerances on the—

lines.speaker: crankpot
lines.text: It is trying to kill us.

lines.speaker: fritzzit
lines.text: Admiringly! I'm saying I admire it admiringly!

lines.speaker: crankpot
lines.text: I'm going to admire it with my wrench.

lines.speaker: fritzzit
lines.text: The smaller units are running hot. If we could somehow introduce a coolant—

lines.speaker: crankpot
lines.text: I have fourteen potions of water.

lines.speaker: fritzzit
lines.text: That's — wait, why do you have fourteen—

lines.speaker: crankpot
lines.text: I am always prepared.

lines.speaker: fritzzit
lines.text: You are magnificent.

lines.speaker: fritzzit
lines.text: THAT EXHAUST MANIFOLD IS LOAD-BEARING—

lines.speaker: crankpot
lines.text: I see it.

lines.speaker: fritzzit
lines.text: IF IT GOES WE'LL HAVE ABOUT FOUR SECONDS—

lines.speaker: crankpot
lines.text: I see it, Fritzzit.

lines.speaker: fritzzit
lines.text: Okay. Okay. You see it. Good. Good.
